mapper.select: SELECT DATE (created_at) AS date, COUNT (DISTINCT user_id) AS activeCounts FROM ( SELECT created_at, user_id FROM comments UNION ALL SELECT created_at, user_id FROM user_interactions UNION ALL SELECT created_at, user_id FROM forum_shares UNION ALL SELECT created_at, user_id FROM forum_questions UNION ALL SELECT created_at, user_id FROM forum_answers ) AS all_actions WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE (created_at) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT title AS name, (views + likes * 2 + comment_count * 3) AS value FROM recipes ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
